prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: production raster texture atlas for a website globe made of photographic tiles.
Create ONE landscape raster image, preferably 2048 by 1536 pixels. It must contain exactly 16 separate editorial photographs arranged as a precisely uniform 4-column by 4-row matrix, filling the entire canvas edge to edge. Every photograph occupies exactly one sixteenth of the canvas, 25 percent of the image width and 25 percent of the image height. All straight vertical tile boundaries are at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% of canvas width; all horizontal tile boundaries at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% of canvas height. No margins, no frames, no gutters, no overlap, no blended transitions, no decorative mosaic. All 16 equal rectangular tiles are landscape crops. This is a technical image atlas, so the strict aligned grid is essential.

Row 1, left to right: candid close-up of a fictional Black woman aged 30 outdoors with a warm relaxed smile; fictional East Asian man aged 35 near a cafe window; fictional Mediterranean woman aged 45 in natural city daylight; fictional South Asian man aged 50 with realistic skin texture in soft shade.
Row 2, left to right: everyday sunny walkable street with a few distant adults and warm architecture; outdoor cafe terrace with cups and chairs, foliage, no signage; quiet modern travel station platform without readable signage; inviting remote-work desk by a window with closed notebook, plain laptop, coffee and plant, screen blank.
Row 3, left to right: fictional Latin American woman aged 28 glancing thoughtfully off-camera; fictional white European man aged 55 in simple neutral clothing outdoors; fictional Southeast Asian woman aged 40 with a candid smile; fictional Black man aged 32 in casual clothing, relaxed profile near greenery.
Row 4, left to right: colorful local produce market stall without signage or crowds; coastal architecture with palm trees and bright sea; modern city skyline in soft late-afternoon light; two adult friends aged 30–40 meeting in an outdoor urban setting.

Style: coherent natural editorial lifestyle photography, believable proportions and authentic texture, softly warm natural light, rich but credible colors. Different photo scenes, like a carefully curated travel and everyday-life contact sheet. Each portrait is head and shoulders with centered face and ample context, suitable for a small thumbnail. All people are fictional adults 25–60, everyday contemporary attire, no stereotypical costumes. Keep the pictures visually readable at thumbnail size.
Constraints: exactly 4 by 4 photographs, absolutely no text anywhere, no labels, no numbers, no watermarks, no logos, no brandmarks, no cash, no banknotes, no payment cards, no UI or finance imagery, no children, no dense crowds. The outside image bounds coincide with the outer photograph bounds. Preserve perfect geometric quarter boundaries.
inspection: Visually inspected 4×4 grid: eight adult portraits in rows 1 and 3, eight everyday places and moments in rows 2 and 4; edge-to-edge photographs, no gutters, labels, logos, banknotes, cash or payment cards. Rows align to the quarter boundaries within raster half-pixel rounding.
